ticket.summary: Gas water heater pilot won't stay lit (drops out ~10 min after relight) since tonight, no hot water; no gas smell, no leaking — likely thermocouple; unit installed by us last year, possible part warranty.
mitigation_advice: Stop repeated relight attempts and turn the water heater's gas control dial to OFF until the tech arrives [PB-04]
If any gas/rotten-egg smell develops, leave the building with everyone, don't touch switches or appliances, and call the gas utility or 911 from outside [PB-06]

quote_lines.description: Water heater pilot/thermocouple service (part may be covered under install warranty - tech to verify)

ticket.customer_message: You're all set, Sam - 77 Birchwood Ln, tomorrow (Tue Sept 1) at 8:00 AM, first slot of the day. Keep the gas dial off tonight [PB-04], and for the baby you can safely warm water on the stove in the meantime. If you do notice any gas smell before then, get everyone outside and call the gas utility or 911 from outside [PB-06] - then ring us. See you in the morning!
